issues.summary: Pacific Star Shipping refused to issue the D/O for MBL PSSU260555 / container PSSU2398736 because no telex release had been received from origin, delaying cargo release by about 2 days.
Premature D/O request before telex release confirmation led to 2 days of demurrage costing USD 560 on container PSSU2398736 (HBL MFCIM260015).

decisions.summary: Meridian absorbs the USD 560 demurrage on HBL MFCIM260015 as a Meridian error and will not bill it to Daehan Precision.
The import team is to be re-trained on SOP-02 section 2.4 with a reminder circulated to all import handlers to prevent premature D/O requests.

tasks.summary: Instruct Pacific Star Shipping to telex release MBL PSSU260555 and forward the release confirmation to Jiwoo Han.
Re-train the team on SOP-02 section 2.4 and circulate a reminder to everyone handling imports.
Inform Soyeon Moon once the carrier confirms the telex release and the D/O for container PSSU2398736 is in hand.
